entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.17.0: Smooth: smooth faces from an STL's triangles
entry.content:
Added

  • Smooth makes only the triangle faces smooth after STL → STEP: planes, cylinders, cones, spheres, tori and profiles become real smooth faces, flat faces stay as they are. The solid is checked sound before it is kept.
  • Mesh Section cuts a Solid too (after Smooth, an imported STEP, any part): into a picked sketch or through a sketched line.
  • STEP export that other CAD programs (Plasticity and others) read as it is: no open faces.
  • While picking three points, the plane through them shows.
  • Drawings: an angle size by three points.

Fixed

  • Features on a solid made of an STL's triangles took over a minute each; now about 10 s.
  • An opened or imported file is shown at once.
